$comment: HLT-010 — the renderer-error budget. Every class has a number and a reason. A class not listed here FAILS the gate whatever its count. Raising a budget above 0 needs a reason a reviewer can argue with; 'it was already there' is not one.

classes.reason: Not a runtime reading at all: the dev server could not compile the tree, so the editor under test is a stale or broken bundle. Any count means the gate measured the wrong build and must fail.

classes.match: Attempted to synchronously unmount a root
classes.reason: Fixed by HLT-001 (unmountReactRoot defers the unmount). 132 in Richard's 42-minute session, 0 on a driven one.
Fixed by HLT-002 (captureThumbnail does not capture a hidden webview). 116 events in 42 minutes, 0 on a driven one.

classes.match: Encountered two children with the same key
classes.reason: Fixed by HLT-003 (launcher keys by directory). 10 in 42 minutes.

classes.match: Each child in a list should have a unique "key" prop
classes.reason: Fixed by HLT-003 (every list the drive reaches is keyed).

classes.match: `value` prop on `%s` should not be null|`value` prop on `\w+` should not be null
classes.reason: Fixed by HLT-003 (property inputs render a null style value as an empty controlled field).

classes.match: Cannot update a component .* while rendering a different component
classes.reason: Fixed by HLT-003 for the case it measured. Any new one is a new setState-during-render and is a defect.
Fixed by HLT-004: a dead community credential is forgotten, so /me/path and /me/profile are never requested with it.

Chromium's network log, not an app error: whats-new.ts asks for /whats-new/feed.json on every project open, the feed has never existed, and the client resolves to null without throwing (HLT-013 verdict, 'knowingly unserved'). Only NOT asking removes the line. The gate opens a project twice, so 2. Goes to 0 when the feed is published or the request is dropped.
